root.name: Dutch Defense: Hort-Antoshin System
root.moves: 1. d4 f5 2. c4 Nf6 3. g3 d6 4. Bg2 c6 5. Nc3 Qc7

overview: A Dutch Leningrad-style fianchetto set-up with ...d6, ...c6 and ...Qc7 preparing ...e5. White builds with Nc3, d4 (or d3 and e4) and castles; Black meets it with ...e5 and sometimes ...Na6 and ...Nc5. The structure is closed-ish and the game is a manoeuvring fight with a kingside initiative for Black.

white_ideas.idea: Fianchetto Bg2, Nc3, d4 and then e4 or Qb3

typical_structures.structure: Dutch with d6/c6 against a fianchettoed White bishop

character.notes: The Dutch is known for unbalanced play with a weakened Black king and kingside attacks. Dutch keeps a kingside race.

approach.notes: A recognised, if less common, branch of the Dutch.
